precondition: Test build of frontend + backend; Chair, Secretary and Member accounts supplied by QA lead; a meeting the Chair chairs, in the needed status, with the needed roster. Chrome and a second browser for the two-user cases.

cases.description: Verify the Votes tab lists every vote with its state, kind and turnout.
expected: The tab "Biểu quyết" lists one row per vote: title button, chip "Nháp" (only Chair/Secretary see it) / "Đang mở" / "Đã đóng", "Kín" or "Công khai", and "receipt/eligible" turnout.
The toolbar shows "Tạo biểu quyết" only for the Chair and Secretary.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on the Votes tab of an InProgress meeting with a draft, an open and a closed vote.
procedure: Open the meeting and click the "Biểu quyết" tab.
Look at each row and at the toolbar.

cases.description: Verify an empty meeting shows the empty hint and a gone meeting shows the not-found page.
expected: Empty: "Không có biểu quyết nào để hiển thị." with "Tạo biểu quyết để chuẩn bị trước, khi họp mới mở.".
Revoked meeting: "Bạn không còn xem được biểu quyết của cuộc họp này."
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
A meeting with no votes; a meeting the user was removed from.
procedure: Open the Votes tab of the empty meeting.
Open the Votes tab of the meeting the user was removed from.

cases.description: Verify a closed vote shows bars, counts and — for a public vote — each choice.
expected: Each option shows a bar with its count and percentage.
A public vote lists every voter under "Phiếu từng người" with "(khách)" for Guests and "Không bỏ phiếu" for abstainers.
A secret vote shows only the totals, nothing that pairs a choice with its voter.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on the Votes tab of a meeting with a closed public vote and a closed secret vote.
procedure: Open the closed public vote and look at "Phiếu từng người".
Open the closed secret vote.

cases.description: Verify the Chair creates a draft from the dialog.
expected: "Tạo biểu quyết" opens the dialog with "Nội dung biểu quyết", two "Phương án" rows, "Hình thức" ("Công khai" / "Bỏ phiếu kín"), "Người được bỏ phiếu" (Chủ toạ/Thư ký/Thành viên/Khách) and "Mô tả".
"Lưu nháp" shows "Đang lưu…", then the new row appears with chip "Nháp".
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on the Votes tab of an Approved meeting.
procedure: Click "Tạo biểu quyết".
Enter "Nội dung biểu quyết" = "Thông qua kế hoạch quý IV", keep two options, choose "Công khai", tick "Chủ toạ" and "Thành viên".
Click "Lưu nháp".

cases.description: Verify the dialog refuses an empty configuration before sending.
expected: Empty content: "Nhập nội dung biểu quyết.".
One option: "Cần ít nhất 2 phương án khác nhau, không để trống.".
No role: "Chọn ít nhất một vai trò.".
No request leaves the browser in any of the three cases.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair with "Tạo biểu quyết" open on an Approved meeting.
procedure: Leave "Nội dung biểu quyết" empty and click "Lưu nháp".
Enter content, delete one option, click "Lưu nháp".
Restore two options, untick every role, click "Lưu nháp".

cases.description: Verify the Chair edits a draft and deletes it after confirming.
expected: "Sửa" reopens "Sửa biểu quyết" with the saved values; saving updates the row.
Delete asks "Xoá biểu quyết nháp" — "Xoá nháp …?"; "Xoá" removes the row.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on the Votes tab of a meeting with one draft.
procedure: Click the "Sửa" icon of the draft, change the title, save.
Click the "Xoá" icon and confirm.

cases.description: Verify leaving the create dialog without saving keeps nothing.
procedure: Click "Tạo biểu quyết".
Enter "Nội dung biểu quyết" = "Nháp bỏ dở" with two options.
Click "Huỷ".
In the dialog "Bỏ thay đổi chưa lưu?", confirm leaving.
expected: Step 4 closes both dialogs.
The list shows no "Nháp bỏ dở" row; DevTools > Network shows no POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on the Votes tab of an Approved meeting.

cases.description: Verify the Chair attaches meeting documents to a draft and removes one.
expected: The paperclip menu attaches the chosen meeting documents; the vote shows them with "Đã đọc"/"Chưa đọc" badges.
"Gỡ khỏi biểu quyết" asks "Gỡ … khỏi biểu quyết? Tài liệu vẫn ở trong cuộc họp."; "Gỡ" removes the link, the meeting keeps the file.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on a draft with no documents; the meeting has documents.
procedure: Open the draft, use the paperclip menu to attach a meeting document.
Click "Gỡ khỏi biểu quyết" on the attached document and confirm.

cases.description: Verify a Member never sees the draft's attach controls.
expected: The draft row is not listed for the Member at all.
An open vote shows its documents but no paperclip menu and no "Gỡ khỏi biểu quyết" button.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Member on the Votes tab of a meeting with a draft and an open vote with documents.
procedure: Look for the draft row.
Open the open vote and look at its documents.

cases.description: Verify the Chair opens a draft from its row.
expected: "Mở" asks "Mở …" — "Người bỏ phiếu (…) chốt lúc ngay lúc mở."; confirming starts the vote and the room hears the "Bỏ phiếu" toast.
The row chip becomes "Đang mở".
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on the Votes tab of an InProgress meeting with a draft whose roles cover the roster.
procedure: Click "Mở" on the draft row and confirm.

cases.description: Verify the Chair opens a vote straight from the create form.
expected: "Mở biểu quyết" (enabled only for the Chair while the meeting is running) creates and opens in one step; the row is "Đang mở".
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on the Votes tab of an InProgress meeting.
procedure: Click "Tạo biểu quyết", fill it in, click "Mở biểu quyết".

cases.description: Verify a voter casts one ballot and cannot change it.
expected: The ballot box lists one radio per option; "Gửi phiếu" stays disabled until an option is chosen and every document shows "Đã xác nhận đọc".
After "Gửi phiếu": "Bạn đã gửi phiếu."; the box no longer accepts input ("Gửi rồi không đổi, không rút được.").
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as an eligible Member on an open vote with one document and unread state.
procedure: Open the vote, choose an option, note that "Gửi phiếu" is still disabled.
Open the document, read to the last page, click "Xác nhận đã đọc".
Choose the option and click "Gửi phiếu".

cases.description: Verify a voter outside the fixed list sees the refusal instead of the ballot.
expected: The box shows "Bạn không có trong danh sách bỏ phiếu." and no radio buttons.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as a Member who is not on the vote's fixed eligible list, on an open vote.
procedure: Open the vote.

cases.description: Verify a verified Guest casts a secret ballot from the meeting page.
expected: The Guest sees the ballot box without voter names.
After voting the Guest sees "Bạn đã gửi phiếu."; the secret tally grows by one with no name attached.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
A verified Guest inside a Published meeting with an open secret vote covering Guest.
procedure: Open the vote as the Guest and cast a ballot.

cases.description: Verify the Chair closes an open vote after confirming the counts.
expected: "Đóng phiếu" asks "Đóng …? Đã bỏ n/m; đóng rồi không ai bỏ thêm được."; confirming shows the result bars at once.
Further ballots are refused.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on an open vote with ballots.
procedure: Click "Đóng phiếu" and confirm.
Ask a voter to cast a ballot.

cases.description: Verify cancelling the close confirm keeps the vote open.
procedure: Click "Đóng phiếu" on the open vote.
In the dialog "Đóng biểu quyết", click "Huỷ".
expected: The dialog closes; the row chip stays "Đang mở".
DevTools > Network shows no POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/close.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on an open vote.

cases.description: Verify a Secretary sees no close control on an open vote.
procedure: Open the vote.
expected: The vote shows no "Đóng phiếu" button: only the current Chair closes (otherwise the backend answers 409/MSG230).
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Secretary on an open vote in an InProgress meeting.

cases.description: Verify the Chair records the conclusion once and it cannot be edited.
expected: The form requires "Kết luận" ("Thông qua" / "Không thông qua" / "Hoãn") and accepts an optional "Ghi chú" ("Ghi rồi không sửa được.").
After "Ghi kết luận" the vote shows the conclusion chip ("Thông qua"/"Không thông qua"/"Hoãn"); the form is gone.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on a closed vote with no conclusion.
procedure: Open the vote, choose "Thông qua", add a note, click "Ghi kết luận".
Reload the vote.

cases.description: Verify leaving without recording keeps the vote unconcluded.
procedure: Open the closed vote, choose "Thông qua" and type a note, but do not submit.
Open another vote, then come back to this one.
expected: The vote still shows "Chưa có kết luận."; DevTools > Network shows no POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/votes/{voteId}/conclusion.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
Signed in as the Chair on a closed vote with no conclusion.

cases.description: Verify a Member sees the recorded conclusion after reloading.
procedure: As the Chair, record the conclusion with a note.
As the Member, open the vote.
Press F5.
expected: Step 2 shows the conclusion chip ("Thông qua"/"Không thông qua"/"Hoãn") with the note.
Step 3 shows the same conclusion; it cannot be edited.
preconditions: Frontend and backend running on the test build; browser Chrome (latest), fresh profile or Incognito.
A closed vote with no conclusion; Chair and Member accounts supplied by QA lead.
